summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K with a manual for shareholder participation in an Extraordinary General Meeting scheduled for May 28, 2026. The agenda includes a reformulation of bylaws to align with a new shareholders' agreement disclosed on April 23, 2026, and election of board members and fiscal council. No financial terms, premiums, or special-situation triggers like acquisitions or tender offers are present. This is a routine governance meeting notice. Because the filing is merely an EGM circular without any transaction event, it does not qualify as a special-situation category.
